title: Adoption Flashcards & Risk-Routing Matrix
body:
Purpose:
Quick-reference flashcards for CS reps to interpret adoption signals, compute a lightweight health score, and route cases to the right owner. Designed for on-the-phone and QBR prep use — distilled guidance instead of a long checklist.

Audience:
- CS reps (AE/CSM)
- Renewal managers
- Solutions engineers (for technical blockers)

How to use:
- Memorize 6 primary flashcards (below) for first 2 weeks on the job.
- Run the SQL snippets in the product console to validate signals prior to outreach.
- Use the Risk-Routing Matrix to decide owner and SLA for follow-up.

Scoring philosophy (lightweight):
- Signals are bucketed into: usage, reliability, engagement, outcomes.
- Assign weights (sample below) for a 0-100 health score.
- Quick triage: score <= 45 = high-risk -> immediate playbook; 46-70 = medium -> cohort outreach; >70 = healthy.

Flashcards (compact):
1) Signal: Monthly active model calls (usage drop)
   - Why: Indicates feature adoption or production rollback.
   - Detection query (example): SELECT customer_id, count(*) as calls_last_30d FROM requests WHERE customer_id = :id AND created_at >= now()-interval '30 days' GROUP BY customer_id;
   - Threshold: calls_last_30d < historical_90d_median * 0.5 (weight: 25)
   - Immediate action: Slack quick-check template -> "Hey @owner — we see a 50%+ drop in calls this month vs baseline. Any infra changes, rollout pause, or cost-driven throttles?"
   - Escalate to: CSM; if infra-related, tag SRE/SE.

2) Signal: Rise in 5xx or latency incidents (reliability)
   - Why: Performance issues correlate strongly with churn risk.
   - Detection snippet: compute p95_latency and 5xx_rate over last 24h vs trailing 7d
   - Threshold: p95_latency > baseline*1.4 OR 5xx_rate > 0.5% (weight: 30)
   - Action: Trigger incident triage; open SE ticket, notify on-call. Use escalation template and assign SE triage SLA = 4 hours.

3) Signal: Drop in core workflow completion (engagement)
   - Why: Users start but don't complete, likely UX/regression or model hallucination causing abandon.
   - Detection: funnel completion % decline > 20% week-over-week (weight: 20)
   - Action: Run UX/QA checklist, request prompt-set evals from research. Book 30-min diagnostic call with PM/SE.

4) Signal: Customer-submitted quality regressions (outcomes)
   - Why: Direct signal from end-users; high predictor of escalations and renewals risk.
   - Detection: count of labeled quality tickets or eval failures in last 14 days > 2 (weight: 40)
   - Action: Immediate canary rollback or model variant fallback; coordinate with model ops. Escalate to Product and Research.

5) Signal: Feature-flag toggles / rollback events (deployment)
   - Why: Indicates instability during production experiments or cost controls.
   - Detection: more than 1 rollback in 7 days OR manual disabling of features by admin (weight: 15)
   - Action: Reach out to admin contact, propose a stabilization plan; schedule joint runbook review.

6) Signal: Contract-level signals (commercial)
   - Why: Usage versus committed capacity, invoice disputes, or legal/regulatory flags materially affect renewals.
   - Detection: usage < 30% of committed capacity for >60 days OR open legal/compliance tickets (weight: 35)
   - Action: Alert Renewal Manager + AE. Offer usage review and credit/contract repricing discussion.

Sample lightweight scoring formula (rep-friendly):
- Compute each triggered signal score = weight * severity_factor (severity_factor in {0.0,0.5,1.0,1.5})
- Health score = 100 - min(100, sum(signal_scores))
- Example: if reliability high-sev (30*1.5=45) + drop usage (25*1.0=25) => sum=70 -> health=30 (high risk).

Risk-Routing Matrix (triage rules):
- High-risk (score <=45): Owner = CSM; Immediate SLA = 24h; If reliability or quality signals present -> parallel SE/Research engage (on-call triage).
- Medium-risk (46-70): Owner = CSM; Outreach SLA = 3 business days; Consider canary rollback or targeted coaching.
- Low-risk (>70): Owner = Success Operations; Quarterly check-in; include in QBR as healthy note.

Owner mapping quick table (use as mnemonic):
- Product/quality regressions -> Research/Product -> Escalate immediately
- Latency/5xx -> SE / SRE -> Trigger infra incident
- Usage decline -> CSM -> Growth/Enablement playbook
- Contract gaps -> Renewal Manager -> Commercial touch

Action templates (short):
- Initial outreach (email subject): "Quick check: usage drop for {product_area} — can we align?"
  Body: Hi {contact}, quick note: we observed a ~{pct_drop}% decline in {metric} over the last {window}. Can we do a 20-minute sync to understand cause and next steps? Prefer times: {3 choices}.

- Incident notify (Slack): "INCIDENT: {customer} p95 {latency} ms (>baseline). CSM triage + SE on-call requested. Link: {incident_url}"

Sample SQL snippets & dashboards to validate (copy-paste friendly):
- Recent calls per day: SELECT date(created_at) as day, count(*) FROM requests WHERE customer_id = :id GROUP BY day ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 30;
- Funnel completion: SELECT step, count(*) FROM events WHERE customer_id = :id AND step IN ('start','complete') GROUP BY step;

Playbook mini-runbook for High-Risk (30-minute guide):
1) Confirm detection: run queries, attach screenshots to ticket.
2) Rapid outreach: use Initial outreach template and call within 4 hours.
3) If reliability/quality: open SE ticket and request model fallback; inform Customer Success Lead and Solutions Eng.
4) Document remediation and next-check date in ticket; follow-up cadence = 48h until resolved.

QBR prep notes (what to include for risk-heavy accounts):
- Top 3 risk signals this quarter with supporting charts (usage, latency, quality labels).
- Actions taken and outcomes (did rollback reduce errors? usage change?).
- Renewal impact estimate: compute projected delta if unresolved (ARR at risk).
- Ask/Motion: list concrete asks (e.g., joint ops call, budget for dedicated capacity).

Open questions / TODOs:
- Agree final weights for scoring across the CS org (proposal: reliability 30, usage 25, outcomes 30, commercial 15).
- Add automation: can we surface a daily "top 20 at-risk" sheet for AMs? (owner: Diego)
- Validate thresholds on a 3-month historical holdout (owner: Research).

Notes & references:
- See Confluence page: CONFLUENCE-1234 for historical score experiments.
- Related Jira: JIRA-CS-872 (pipeline for automation).
